candidates.quote: # K Ashok Reddy, IAS on X: "If your household water storage sump is mixed with rain water, pl empty it and clean & disinfect with bleaching powder and refill sump with HMWSSB water. If your household water storage sump is mixed with rain water, pl empty it and clean & disinfect with bleaching powder and refill sump with HMWSSB water. As precaution pl mix the water with chlorine tablets. Chlorine tablets are distributed by HMWSSB staff at your doorstep.

In response to the recent surge in waterborne illnesses in the Karwan constituency, a special seven member team from the Hyderabad Metropolitan Water Supply and Sewerage Board (HMWSSB) has been deployed on an urgent basis. The move comes after complaints were received regarding contaminated drinking water leading to cases of vomiting, stomach pain, and other health concerns, particularly in areas served by Shaikpet and Allah Banda reservoirs.
